description.content: List recent credit transactions across all users.
Grant credits to a user: platform or challenge level.
Transfer a user's platform credits to a challenge pool.
Get a user's full credit picture: platform + all challenge credits.
Deduct credits from a user: platform or challenge level.
Revoke a previous credit grant: creates a negative transaction and deducts the balance.
Refund remaining pool balance to the host's wallet. Superadmin only.
Get platform credit balance + recent transactions.
Get sponsor pool stats for a challenge. Admin only.
Update pool settings (e.g. num_users). Challenge admin only.
Get user's effective balance for this challenge: wallet + sponsor amount.
Get all funding transactions for this challenge's pool. Admin only.

Get a read-only summary of all child challenge pools in this collection.

Returns a list of child challenge pools with their total funded, used, and remaining
amounts. Collections no longer manage pools directly: each challenge manages its own.
Auth: collection admin or superadmin.
